name: CLUB Natural Hearts
source:
In a world where half-humans and humans live together in peace, I was living an ordinary life.
That is, until one day, when I saved some half-human monster girls from some drunks.
After that, they take me back to their hostess club!?

As I talk to them, I learn about their troubles.
Some to do with their being half-human, some just ordinary girl worries.
The more I learn about them, the more I'm taken in by them.

A game where you choose from 4 half-human girls to chat up while drinking together.
Get to know them better through your conversations, and build up your relationship!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ260986.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在半人与人类和平共处的世界里，我过着平凡的生活。
直到有一天，我从醉汉手中救出了一些半人怪物女孩。
然后他们就带我回他们的女主人俱乐部！？

当我与他们交谈时，我了解到他们的烦恼。
有些是因为她们是半人类，有些只是普通女孩的担忧。
我对他们了解得越多，我就越被他们所吸引。

一款游戏，你可以从4个半人女孩中选择一起喝酒聊天。
通过对话更好地了解他们，并建立你们的关系！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ260986.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
